shared_elements: low-relief carved motif on a vertical panel
possible headdress-like element with radiating or fanned projections
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow curvilinear relief on an upright panel, and each seems to include a face or mask surmounted by a fanned/radiating headdress-like element in the upper zone, which is the only specific correspondence. A, however, presents a legible full composition with a large scroll-eyed zoomorphic mask, volutes and a basal band, whereas B shows only a small, isolated patch of faint incised design on an otherwise blank field, so no shared arrangement or set of relationships can be established.
